scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "web,api,scoring" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:scoring"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
